book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: 2 TIMOTI Poru Gigirum Meuma Duwameba Timoti Menan Tenewa

content: God namive, sira Keriso Iesu me gare vin eme igiyawa ge boriruwayawa igiyawa kepteempewa namive, ne anoeni me uwatanwa ge me toimuwawa, sira ne ge dirukna.
Gae opata wag dirumigima. Yaimoyai meib a, kum oraiwa gumbe ge kum kukaeba gumbe. Iyaiyai wakeg toewan mun, diruma sira dirum anope sira yusiwa muna.
Kuiyawa iyayapan matai toewanewan oraiwa den anope. Sira mu imuwo toewanewan opata me mu anotan anoemewa wape. Meoya anoano muma gumbe toewanewan tam gumbo tepe.
Mu natawa yankweg anoano muma gumbe ainamiya gaiyawa aupe. Meib kumiwa matai uwape.
Megara ge dividivi undag mu yaukapa, sira danadawai geuma me gumbe ugwa nikiyaigima, sira gae oraiwa wateteyamivi abnawa nauwawa aigima, sira yaimoyai nau geuma aigima.
Ne gare puyo egamiviwa atan eni. Ne at piyu mame kwetanwa kumiwa me wait uwane.
Ne mut yusipamit ana, sira ne kin ageyau ana onanane, sira anotumat neuma amarana.
Gare mame anoano oraiwa keret meuma nenan tamibarip anewa baraug wakene. Me kumive Ayapan me keptete abnawa oraiwa me nekpe. Ne nekut onan, iyayapan upeba mu me uwatanwa anoemewa mu gaibu mumpe.
Poru Dividivi Meumawa
Ge yusipamit ag nenan tatevit onaga.
Demas me piyu mame baigan ag ne yankweneg at Tesaronika aine. Sira Kresens me at Garatia aine, Taitosi me at Darumatia aine.
Ruk mekut gunap wakene. Mak aug nenan onaga. Me nau neuma gumbe oraimina.
Sira ne Titikas barauna Epesas aine.
Ne Toroas apa wakenawa Karupas gumbe wape neuma yankweg onedna. Ge nenan ongetan awa wape neuma auka onaga. Sira buka tam onaga. Ne imunap buka me sip kwapiwa gumbe ainamiyawa tam onaga.
Arekisanda me aiyan kopa gumbe guwawa ubeube ainamiviwa me danadawai koka nedne. Ayapan garawa wampe nau meuma oya.
Ge mina gaibu me gumbe yaukapa, kuiyawa me gae numa yusipamit topayane.
Ne gae namuiren wanawa, bira da ne den waita nedne, iyayapan undag ne yankwe negiya. Ne imunap anoeniwa, God mu matai ibnawa den mumpe me oya.

Megara Ayapan ne gunap yokene, sira yusiwa nedne. Kuiyawa Ayapan imive wakenewa, ne gae opata yaimoyai yusipamit wape, sira iyayapan at undag gae anope. Ayapan ne waita nedne mae raion noiwa apa dauwag onedna.
Sira Ayapan waita nekpe dividivi kukaeba undag apa dauwag onetna, sira gwetoimu kwiminauwa danave yaimoyai unikna. Ayapan gumbe eyawa wakepe viripusiwa onan. Amen.
Gaun Meuma Oieba
Priska ge Akuira gumbo nenan gaun wa. Sira Onesiporas ge biviusitainawa gumbo gaun wa.
Erastas at Korint apa wakene, sira Tropimas yuwarane, meoya at Miretas apa yankweg onedna.
Ageyau ag onaga meve taig kumiwa uwape. Yuburas, Puden, Rinas, Kraudia ge tatangwanenaiwa undag genan gaun veme.
Ayapan me guwagwa gaibu wakeigimpe. God ano oraiwa me guniyap wakeigimpe.
